'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Okay, I got word of a major fuck-up. It may not be your fault, but that's beside the point. The assholes at the water treatment plant intercepted a bunch of these crates with portable EW equipment in them. They're obviously useless at this point, but I'm not gonna let them steal government property like this. For a warrior like you, the task is feasible. Go to the WTP and get me those EW thingies. And yes, those rats need to be put down. The EWs themselves have probably already been handed over to their commanders, so you're guaranteed to get this equipment from them. Assuming you don't die, I suppose.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 2 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare device]]s
* Eliminate 10 [[Rogues]]
** (''Optional'') Locate and neutralize [[Big Pipe]]
** (''Optional'') Locate and neutralize [[Birdeye]]
** (''Optional'') Locate and neutralize [[Knight]]

==Rewards==
* 60,400 [[EXP]]
* 200,000 Roubles
** 210,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 230,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[RGO hand grenade]]
* 3× [[RGN hand grenade]]
* 2× [[Degtyarev RPDN 7.62x39 machine gun]]
* 2× [[RPD 7.62x39 Buben 100-round box]]
* 5× [[7.62x39mm PP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* 10× [[7.62x39mm PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* 5× [[7.62x39mm T-45M1 gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
{{quote|Splendid, the new toys have arrived. My guys are gonna love these. You need to be ready for anything these days, and such protection is definitely not superfluous.}}
